canonical.title: Course Schedule — Can All Courses Be Finished?
canonical.sourceFilePath: 13. Graphs/3. Topo Sort Problems/03. Course Scheduler 1.cpp

narrative.title: The Training-Pass Feasibility Check
narrative.scenario: A certification body offers numbered training passes, some of which require earlier passes first. Each requirement is one-way: pass A demands pass B beforehand. Before publishing the term plan, the registrar must confirm no circular requirement chain makes the whole program impossible to complete.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer numCourses and a list prerequisites where each pair [a, b] means course b must be taken before course a.
narrative.outputFormat: Return true if all courses can be completed in some order, otherwise false.

testCases.explanation: Each course demands the other first — an impossible circular requirement.

hintLevels: Level 1: Reframe requirements as directed edges — the question is exactly 'is this graph a DAG?'
Level 2: Count how many courses have no pending requirement and keep unlocking as you finish them.
Level 3: If the unlock count ever falls short of numCourses, a circular chain is the culprit.
